# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 4 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 4 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_004_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 4

**4:1** Then an angel of the Lord appeared to her and said: "Anna, Anna, the Lord God has heard your prayer. You will conceive and give birth, and your offspring will be proclaimed throughout all the world."

**4:2** Anna said: "As the Lord God lives, whether the child I bear is male or female, I will present it as an offering to the Lord my God. It shall serve before him all the days of its life."

**4:3** Then two messengers arrived, saying to her: "Your husband Joachim is on his way with his flocks." For an angel of the Lord had appeared to him as well, saying: "Joachim, Joachim, the Lord God has heard your prayer. Come down from here, for your wife Anna has conceived in her womb."

**4:4** Joachim went down at once and summoned his shepherds: "Bring me ten unblemished ewe-lambs as an offering for the Lord my God; bring me twelve calves for the priests and the elders; and bring me a hundred male goats for all the people."

**4:5** And when Joachim arrived with his flocks, Anna was standing at the gate. She saw him coming, ran to meet him, and threw her arms around his neck, saying: "Now I know that the Lord God has blessed me abundantly. For see — the widow is a widow no longer, and the childless woman shall conceive."

**4:6** And Joachim rested the first day in his house.
